summary: Thunder Compute's Student Program gives students enrolled at a US university $20 of free credit when they sign up with their university email. The credit can be used on A6000 and L40 GPUs. When the credit runs out, normal pay-as-you-go billing applies; the student page does not state a fixed expiration date. The general Quickstart instructs adding a payment method. Billing supports saved-card auto-pay or preloaded credit; confirm the student-credit launch requirements before starting an instance. Promotional credit can be revoked. Do not assume the non-expiry rule for purchased/preloaded credit guarantees student-credit validity.
claim_steps: Confirm that you are enrolled at a US university and have a university email address.
Sign up for Thunder Compute with your student email.
Use the automatic $20 credit on supported A6000 or L40 GPUs; normal pay-as-you-go billing applies after it is exhausted.

Check console payment/funding requirements before launching: the general Quickstart says to add a payment method, and billing offers saved-card auto-pay or preloaded credit. Do not assume the student grant waives launch checks; delete instances when finished.
